# Why did your bank reject these SEPA payments?

> Free SEPA pain.002 reader: which payments your bank rejected, what each code (AC04, AM04, MD01) means, what to fix. In your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/sepa-pain002-status-reader/)
